title: A Study to Evaluate Safety, Pharmacokinetics, and Activity of GDC-7035 as a Single Agent and in Combination in Patients With Advanced Solid Tumors
official: A Phase I/II Dose-Escalation and Expansion Study Evaluating the Safety, Pharmacokinetics, and Activity of GDC-7035 as a Single Agent and in Combination With Other Anti-Cancer Therapies in Patients With Advanced Solid Tumors With a KRAS G12D Mutation
summary: This is a first-in-human Phase I/II, open-label, multicenter, dose-escalation and expansion study designed to evaluate the safety, pharmacokinetics, and preliminary activity of GDC-7035 as a single agent and in combination with other anti-cancer therapies in participants with advanced or metastatic solid tumors that harbor the KRAS G12D mutation.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Histologically documented advanced or metastatic solid tumor with KRAS G12D mutation
* Agreement to adhere to the contraception requirements described in the protocol for participants of childbearing potential and participants who produce sperm

Exclusion criteria:

* Malabsorption or other condition that would interfere with enteral absorption
* Active brain metastases
* Clinically significant cardiovascular dysfunction or liver disease
